pattern: percentage-point change between two labelled rounds on messy headers, state filter, detail rows only
question: NFHS-5 minus NFHS-4 fully vaccinated percent for every Bihar district, don't include the state total row
gold_sql: SELECT "District", MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) AS change_pp FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "State" = 'Bihar' AND "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: WITH nfhs4 AS (SELECT District, "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs4_vaccinated FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' AND State = 'Bihar' AND NOT District IN ('State Total')), nfhs5 AS (SELECT District, "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs5_vaccinated FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' AND State = 'Bihar' AND NOT District IN ('State Total')) SELECT n4.District, n4.nfhs4_vaccinated, n5.nfhs5_vaccinated, (n5.nfhs5_vaccinated - n4.nfhs4_vaccinated) AS vaccinated_diff FROM nfhs4 AS n4 JOIN nfhs5 AS n5 ON n4.District = n5.District ORDER BY n4.District NULLS FIRST
